answer:
Going by your records as of their latest update in mid-October 2026, you have two active medicines:

1. Atorvastatin 20 mg tablets (a statin for cholesterol). Take one tablet by mouth once daily. It was prescribed on 20 February 2025.
2. Jardiance 10 mg tablets (for diabetes). Take one tablet by mouth once daily in the morning. It was prescribed on 20 February 2025.

Metformin 500 mg is listed as completed and ended on 15 April 2024, so it is not on your current list.

Your records do not show any other medicines, including over-the-counter ones. If you take anything else, or if your doses have changed since these records were made, please check with your doctor or pharmacist.
